warning.titlePre: Land Rover Discovery Sport D240 Ingenium Diesel Timing Chain & Oil Dilution
paragraphs: If your Discovery Sport D240 is a 2019–2020 model with the Ingenium AJ200D diesel, timing chain tensioner wear and oil dilution from DPF regeneration are well-documented patterns on this engine family, backed by established UK specialist consensus. We replace timing chains, injector seals, EGR components and gaskets as standard on every Ingenium diesel rebuild.

One owner-forum source noted the D240 might not share the oil dilution issue affecting other diesels in the range — this is not independently corroborated and is noted for awareness only. We treat all Ingenium diesel rebuilds to the same comprehensive standard, regardless of badge.
warning.source: Source: shared Ingenium diesel family pattern, multiple forums, per VRF-landrover-discovery-sport.md. D240 oil dilution note flagged from single forum source — not confirmed, flagged for VRF awareness only
